t: Solvent free, high tack grab adhesive for effective bonding on the most common building materials. High initial grab properties provide an instant fix between materials, such as wood, stone, wall tiles, metal and most plastics. Versatile, multi-purpose adhesive with minimal odour. Ideal for interior bonding applications. Very good gap filling capabilities, and suitable for use on uneven surfaces. At least one surface must be porous. Sandable.
